web.title: Nimi Lab Web
web.intro: Use the Lab workbench to test AI and Local Agents on your PC Runtime from this browser.
web.configure: This deployment needs its HTTPS source and Nimi connection settings.
web.prerequisite: Keep Nimi Home running on the primary PC with remote access enabled. Confirm this Lab source in Home once on first use.
web.failed: The operation could not be completed.
web.scope: This browser uses the existing AI workbench, App AIConfig, run history, Agent Center and Agent conversations. Native App Access diagnostics, Integration, activity, realtime media sessions, World Tour and annotation document saving still require the native carrier. Direct App asset writes and PC file reveal are not available on this carrier.
web.network: Traffic goes directly to the PC. A network that cannot establish a direct connection reports unavailable; no relay or business proxy is used.
web.nativeSurface: This surface is not yet supported by the Web carrier. Use native Nimi Lab for this test. The AI workbench, Agent Center and Agent conversations are available here.
web.nativeOperation: This operation requires the native Lab carrier.
web.connectedIdentity: Connected using the verified Nimi user and this Lab source.
web.connectionDetail: Connected directly to the primary Runtime. App AIConfig and Runtime operation owners determine which capabilities can execute.
web.disconnected: The direct connection is closed. Reconnect when the PC and network are available.

errors.appSource: Lab requires an ecosystem App source, not an official management source.
errors.loginExpired: This sign-in attempt has expired. Start Nimi sign-in again.

states.signed-out: Sign in on the official Nimi page to discover your primary Runtime.
states.waiting-for-pc: Waiting for the PC. On first use, confirm the Lab source in Home.
states.connected: Connected directly to your primary Runtime.
states.disconnected: Disconnected. You can reconnect without another Home approval for the same source.

actions.restartDevCommand: Run the official development command again.
actions.registerProject: Register the current App ID, project root, shell, and App Access declaration through Nimi Desktop.
actions.openDesktopAndRetry: Open Nimi Desktop, confirm Runtime is available, then retry.
actions.restartThroughSupervisor: Close this process and relaunch the project through Nimi Desktop.
actions.signInToDesktop: Sign in through Nimi Desktop, then retry without relaunching this App.
actions.reopenSession: Reopen the protected local-app session through Nimi Desktop.
actions.waitForAdmission: Protected App Access is not available in this Runtime phase.

account.sessionRequired: Nimi Lab requires a verified Desktop-supervised local-app session.
account.sessionBoundDetail: The protected identity session is bound independently. Protected App Access operations remain unavailable until Runtime establishes the common ingress. This App receives no account token, registration handle, or subject identifier.
